title: Reading Drill — Studying book exchanges on stations — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Studying book exchanges on stations — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The exchange volunteer in Hillswick received an old report about popular shelves filling with books in poor condition. The report compared the share of books suitable for exchange, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the sample checks rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered seven weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include station closure times. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a clear condition notice as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
